instructions.purpose: Search the public web for current or external information that is not available in the conversation context.

tool.name: web-search
tool.description: Searches DuckDuckGo HTML results and returns organic result titles, URLs, and snippets. Empty results are allowed and mean no relevant result was found by the search endpoint.

usage_rules.rule: Use this only when the user needs current, external, or source-backed information.
Do not use it for simple conversation, internal memory recall, or facts already present in context.
Prefer a focused query and a limit of 3-5 unless the user asks for broader research.
Use web-fetch afterward only when result content is needed to answer accurately.
Do not claim you searched if the tool failed; explain briefly that search was unavailable.

example.context: User asks: "What changed in Bun this week?"
User asks: "How do I use the Discord.js Client class?"
